description: Per-file provenance contract for every A-22+ vendored OpenHands UI file. Enforced by scripts/check-agent-upstream-adoption.mjs (G5).
rule: 1:1 — every file under apps/workspace/upstream/openhands/src must have a provenance entry; every provenance entry must map to a real file.

entry_shape.upstream_path: src/... (path within OpenHands repo at the frozen ref)
entry_shape.upstream_source_sha256: sha256 of the exact upstream file content at the frozen ref
entry_shape.vendored_sha256: sha256 of the vendored file after minimal adaptation
entry_shape.adoption_class: KEEP_AS_IS | KEEP_WITH_MINIMAL_PATCH | KEEP_STRUCTURE_REPLACE_DOMAIN_CONTENT | REMOVE_CODING_SURFACE | EXCLUDE_RUNTIME | EXCLUDE_LICENSE

generation: Produced programmatically during A-22 from the frozen ref + import-closure; not hand-written.
source_of_truth: GitHub official repository + Tag v1.10.0 + 40-char SHA + this lock. Not the A-21 eval ZIP, not any local clone.
